description: NaLiFePO₄F is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.48 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.38 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.55 Å. The Li-F bond length is 2.06 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three O and one F atom. There is one shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.13 Å) Li-O bond lengths. The Li-F bond length is 1.88 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form FeO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₄F₂ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.08 Å) and two longer (2.22 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. Both Fe-F bond lengths are 2.14 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form FeO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₄F₂ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.10 Å) and two longer (2.15 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. Both Fe-F bond lengths are 2.20 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-51°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂LiP tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂LiFe₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂LiP tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FNa₂LiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids and corners with four equivalent ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Fe and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Li, two equivalent Fe, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Li, and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted FNa₂LiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂LiP tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂LiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li and two equivalent Fe atoms.
